purpose: helldivers.bot is a Next.js 16 App Router monolith around a normalized Postgres schema, fed by an in-process worker thread.
eli14: The app is a single restaurant kitchen. One stove (the Postgres lease row) decides which of the many identical kitchens cooks right now, so the meal is cooked once. Only a cook who takes more than a minute can overlap with the next kitchen's cook. Whatever the stove cooks is chopped into fixed-size time buckets and stored in five normalized baskets; the counter, the menu board, and the takeaway API all read from those baskets, never from a raw tape.
prose:
## Rules

- One lease holder at a time across replicas via the 60 s `worker_heartbeat` lease (a poll slower
  than 60 s can overlap with the next holder's poll); handover state
  (`prevEvents`, `lastSeasonObserved`) lives in the lease row, never in module memory.
- No raw-cache tables: the rebroadcast and public APIs reconstruct wire format from the normalized
  `h1_*` tables on read.
- Timeseries writes are bucket-upserts by `season + enemy + bucket` (event progress by
  `type + event_id + bucket`), not an append-only log.
- All upstream data is Zod-validated before any database write.
- Live views filter to active events through `computeLiveMap` only.
- All dates render with `timeZone: 'UTC'`, except the forecast times of `NextWaveCard`, which show
  the visitor's local time.

parts.name: API consumer
parts.does: An external consumer of the public versioned v1 API. It needs an API key and has a rate limit.

parts.name: Visitor
parts.does: Opens the live dashboard and the archives, signs in when auth is on, and can enable notifications.

parts.name: Dashboard
parts.does: The live home page: galaxy map, stat grid, event cards and timeline, fed by a poll of the live route every 10 s.

parts.name: Notifications and PWA
parts.does: Event-transition toasts, Web Notifications and web-push, the installable PWA, and the stale-version reload.

parts.name: API
parts.does: Serves the stored war record: internal update and live routes, a key-gated v1 API, and an HD1-format rebroadcast.

parts.name: Archives
parts.does: Shows every past season. A season missing from the database is fetched from the HD1 API on its first request.

parts.name: Auth and admin
parts.does: Optional BetterAuth sign-in, public API keys and the admin section. Auth is off by default.

parts.name: Update pipeline
parts.does: Polls the official HD1 API about every 20 s, validates the data and bucket-upserts it, with one lease holder across replicas.

parts.name: OAuth providers
parts.does: Discord, GitHub and Google. BetterAuth signs a user in through them when auth is on.

parts.name: Postgres
parts.does: Holds the normalized h1 tables, the worker_heartbeat lease row, and the auth, API key and push tables.

parts.name: HD1 API
parts.does: The official Helldivers 1 API. It serves the campaign status and the season snapshots that the app polls.
